description: This file implements a command-line interface (CLI) program for managing Playwright browser sessions, including commands for listing, opening, closing, installing browsers, and managing daemons. It handles user input, session management, and process control.

classes.name: Session
classes.description: Represents a browser session, providing methods to start, stop, delete data, check connectivity, and run commands.

methods.name: program
methods.description: Main entry point for the CLI program, parsing arguments and dispatching commands.

methods.name: runInSession
methods.description: Executes a command within a specific browser session.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Initializes the workspace, installs skills if requested, and ensures a configured browser is installed.

methods.name: ensureConfiguredBrowserInstalled
methods.description: Checks and installs the configured browser based on existing config or defaults.

methods.name: installBrowser
methods.description: Triggers installation of the default browser.

methods.name: createDefaultConfig
methods.description: Creates a default browser configuration file with specified channel.

methods.name: findOrInstallDefaultBrowser
methods.description: Detects or installs a default browser (chrome, msedge, chromium).

methods.name: defaultConfigFile
methods.description: Returns the path to the default configuration file.

methods.name: killAllDaemons
methods.description: Kills all running daemon processes related to the application.

methods.name: listSessions
methods.description: Lists all browser sessions, optionally including server entries.

methods.name: gcAndPrintSessions
methods.description: Garbage collects and prints session statuses.

methods.name: gcAndPrintBrowserSessions
methods.description: Prints information about available browser descriptors.

methods.name: renderSessionStatus
methods.description: Renders the status of a session, including version and connection status.

methods.name: calculateSha1
methods.description: Calculates SHA-1 hash of a buffer or string.
